name: Mental Link (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Level 10

Effect: The companion forms a magical link between itself and the vanguard, allowing them to communicate telepathically. This functions out to any range, including through walls, so long as the companion is not shut down.

Resonance: The mental link expands to allies within 30 feet, letting them communicate as a telepathic bond spell. They do not need to remain within 30 feet to continue communicating. The resonance lasts for 10 minutes.
